title: False Cases
intro: If you or someone you know has been targeted with a false or fabricated case related to the July uprising, you can securely submit timestamped evidence here. Every submission is forensically checked and visible only to authorized administrators.

private.title: Fully private
private.body: Your evidence and contact details are never shown on the public portal.

forensic.title: Forensically checked
forensic.body: Every photo or document is screened for manipulation and duplicates, strengthening the credibility of your evidence.

track.title: Reference provided
track.body: You receive a short reference after submission for follow-up with the review team.

loginNote: Citizen sign-in is required so only you can track your private submission.
submitDescription: Fill in the accused person's details, the circumstances, and supporting evidence (image or document) below. Your evidence is analyzed automatically before submission.
anonymousNotice: You are signed in. Only you and authorized administrators can access the submitted evidence.

form.victimQuestion: Are you the person affected by this case?
form.victimQuestionDescription: Choose the option that accurately describes who is making this submission.

self.title: Yes, I am the affected person
self.description: The case or allegation directly concerns me.

representative.title: No, I am submitting for someone else
representative.description: I am helping a victim, family member, or authorized representative.

form.evidenceDescription: Add up to five images, PDFs, videos, audio files, or documents. Applicable forensic checks run locally before upload.
form.detailsDescription: Provide enough information for an authorized reviewer to assess and securely follow up.
form.description: Description of the incident and why this is a false case
form.duplicateWarningDescription: A similar file appears to have already been submitted. You can still submit — an admin will review it.
form.successDescription: Your evidence has been submitted and is awaiting admin review. We'll reach out using your provided contact details if needed.

errors.descriptionTooShort: Please add a bit more detail (at least 10 characters).
errors.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.contactRequired: Provide an email address or phone number for secure follow-up.
errors.uploadFailed: File upload failed. Please try again.
errors.analysisFailed: Could not analyze the file. Try a different file.
errors.tooManyFiles: You can attach up to {max} files.
errors.totalTooLarge: The combined file size cannot exceed 100MB.
errors.unsupportedFile: {name} is not a supported evidence format.
errors.fileTooLarge: {name} exceeds the size limit for that file type.
